Thanks for suggesting an improvement to Riottosa.

Before submitting your proposal, please check whether a similar request has already been discussed.

## What would you like to improve or add?

Please describe your proposal as clearly as possible.

## Area of the project

Does your suggestion concern:

- glyph design;
- character set;
- spacing or kerning;
- variable axes or interpolation;
- font files;
- website/specimen;
- documentation;
- another part of the project?

## Why would this be useful?

Please describe the problem your suggestion would solve or how it could improve Riottosa.

## Proposed solution

If you already have an idea for how the improvement could be implemented, describe it here.

## Examples or references

If relevant, attach visual examples, references, sketches, or other useful material.

## Additional information

Add anything else that may help explain your proposal.
